parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a library or bookstore. The walls are made of wood and the floor is made of marble. On the left side of the image, there is a large wooden bookshelf with multiple shelves filled with books of different sizes and colors. The shelves are arranged in a way that creates a sense of depth and dimension. In the background, there are several rows of bookshelves with different types of books on them. The ceiling is high and has a modern design with recessed lighting. There are several potted plants scattered throughout the space, adding a touch of greenery to the space. A few people can be seen sitting at tables and browsing the books. The overall atmosphere of the space is cozy and inviting.
